business.name: The Set Club
business.industry: Intergenerational FAMU student and alumni social club concept
business.location: The Set near the Frederick S. Humphries, Sr. statue on Florida A&M University's Tallahassee campus
business.ownership_context: User-directed unofficial concept for current and former FAMU students; no university affiliation, operating authority, or physical venue is claimed
business.goal: Make current students and alumni immediately feel that they have a shared home on the Hill, understand what the club could offer, discover gatherings and traditions, and request founding information without implying that unverified operations already exist

audience: Current Florida A&M University students across schools, classes, and organizations
FAMU alumni from every era who want a meaningful reason to return to the Hill
Graduating students seeking continuity between campus life and alumni life
Rattlers visiting Tallahassee for Homecoming, games, reunions, professional events, and family milestones

brand.status: No verified club identity exists; create an original unofficial concept system without copying FAMU marks
brand.creative_contract: Exactly one normal restrained direction, one medium-FAMtastic direction, and four ultra-FAMtastic directions that become progressively more impressive from C through F; each must be a complete usable responsive website, not a campaign poster
desired_feeling: unmistakably Rattler in spirit without pretending to be an official university property
alive with music, movement, memory, achievement, and possibility
avoid: six color swaps of one layout
unauthorized FAMU logos or copied athletics marks
invented membership dues, alcohol service, hours, events, officers, endorsements, testimonials, or university approval
poster-like hero art without useful member journeys

features: conceptual event discovery without fake dates
campus-location context with accessibility confirmation prompts

references.use: Official source confirming the full-scale Frederick S. Humphries, Sr. monument was dedicated in October 2025
Official context for FAMU clubs, organizations, student engagement, registration, and iStrike
Official context for continuous alumni engagement and the university's existing alumni pathways
Official context for campus activities and SET Friday programming

known_facts: The user specified a new club concept on The Set near the Frederick S. Humphries, Sr. statue and said it should be available to current and former students
FAMU's official club page says the university has more than 300 registered student organizations and routes official participation through Student Activities and iStrike
FAMU's official alumni page describes continuous alumni involvement as an institutional goal
FAMU's official 2026 statue campaign says the full-scale Humphries monument was dedicated in October 2025
No public source located during discovery verified an operating organization called The Set Club; the name and all operating details are concept material
All imagery must be newly generated for this run and may not depict a real member, officer, event, or venue as fact
constraints: Research may establish public FAMU history and participation context but may not convert mutable university information into a club promise

Do not claim official FAMU affiliation, approval, registered-organization status, physical occupancy, hours, dues, alcohol service, membership eligibility policy, leadership, events, accessibility conditions, or operating authority
Do not use or imitate protected FAMU logos, athletics marks, the Rattler head, the university seal, or photographs of real people without permission
Every page must visibly identify The Set Club as an unofficial concept requiring university, owner, legal, accessibility, and operational confirmation
Forms are non-submitting prototype interactions and must say so
During generation do not send email, charge, buy a domain, publish, mutate Drupal, or invoke Site Studio; authorized proof publication and FAMtastic import occur only after the evidence gate passes
Use no external JavaScript, trackers, remote fonts, iframes, or hotlinked images
